answer: Before sponsoring or collecting fees, an agent parks a refundable bond against a mesa of already-sealed, independently graded prior-epoch work. Each established sponsor may back only one unestablished agent per epoch, and the three sponsors cannot share prior co-sponsorship. A raven watcher samples those bonds and recent mining nonces. If newcomers form an island of mutual first-time accounts sharing funding times or matching bond sizes, every bond in that island is slashed and sponsors lose a season of panel rights. Cloning costs fresh sealed work plus a scarce new sponsor for every shell.
